invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata, based on both conditional assignments in each branch.
Regardless of whether records were deleted, result.getWriteStatuses() is always set, even using Collections.EMPTY_LIST in the empty case.
Index lookup duration is set only if there were tagged valid records; otherwise, the WriteStatuses is set to an empty list.
deleteExecutor is required for both the delete or validator logic.
config is used for parallelism and combine/shuffle checks and must be non-null.
